profiles: The pinned native releases and name profiles. Omitted access methods resolve to InnoDB on MySQL and heap on PostgreSQL. The fixture uses these defaults and observes each native transaction policy.
scope: Create one persistent ordinary table at a resolved schema identity with one or more named SMALLINT, INTEGER or BIGINT columns, nullable or not nullable, and optional explicit NULL or signed 32-bit literal defaults. Preserve IF NOT EXISTS.
open: Non-ASCII MySQL column names, other types, type modifiers, defaults, constraints, temporary and unlogged tables, partitioning, inheritance, LIKE, CREATE TABLE AS and other engine options

CreateTable.role: Private definition of a named native table
invariants: Dense ordered list of 1 to 128 checked columns
Names are distinct under the native column comparison
The relation identity uses the existing checked table-name role
CreateTable.meaning: Create the declared ordered column layout and defaults. IF NOT EXISTS leaves a preexisting object alone. MySQL uses InnoDB and its implicit commit rule. PostgreSQL uses heap and its transactional DDL rule.
CreateTable.sql: Emit a schema-qualified CREATE TABLE with every checked column and an explicit checked access method.

TableColumn.role: An ordered column with signed native integer kind, nullability and an optional literal default
invariants: MySQL column names use ASCII for the pinned case comparison. PostgreSQL column names exclude system attribute names.
MySQL checks an integer default against the native width. PostgreSQL stores a literal default and checks the assignment on insertion.
MySQL NOT NULL does not admit an explicit NULL default

IntegerStorage.role: The signed 16-, 32- or 64-bit native storage role

analysis: Resolve the declaration schema and builtin integer kind in the fixed profile. Map only the checked column attributes. Preserve the distinction between no explicit default and explicit NULL where represented.
observations: Ordinal names, exact native declared types, nullability and default metadata

columnForms: NOT NULL with an integer default
finite.completeness: Observe all 48 constructor and prior-target combinations per release.

additionalPostgreSqlNegatives: Text literal default in signed storage
correction: The PostgreSQL SMALLINT outside-width case creates a table. Its default insertion reports SQLSTATE 22003 and an explicit replacement row succeeds. The signed-default domain compares both effects. MySQL still rejects the case at construction.
faults: Change a signed integer storage role
trust: Pinned builtin integer roles and access-method settings
